_**User (2026-11-28 11:44:02Z)**_

Build ONE page: pages/find-your-trip.html for Highland Horizons (Northern Pakistan tour company).

TECH STACK: Only HTML5, CSS3, vanilla JS. Bootstrap 5.3.3 only, using the exact CDN links and integrity hashes from header-footer-preview.html. No other frameworks or libraries, no npm.

RULES: Do NOT run git commands. Do NOT edit components/*, assets/css/layout.css, assets/js/layout.js, or any login files. Do NOT delete/rename files. Page code goes only in pages/find-your-trip.html, assets/css/find-your-trip.css, assets/js/find-your-trip.js. Keep code simple and commented for a viva.

SHARED LAYOUT: Same structure as pages/login.html (site-header/site-footer placeholders, data-base-path="..", layout.css then page css, layout.js then page js). Reuse --hh-* variables and match the login page's style and subtle animations.

DESIGN: Match docs/design-references/find-your-trip-desktop.png and find-your-trip-mobile.png. Extra states are in docs/prototype-photos/26i-3255_vertical.jpg: question screen, "Please select an answer to continue" error, result screen "Your Match" with image, View Package and Retake.

FEATURES
1. Data-driven quiz: 5 questions stored in a JS array of objects and rendered by JS (none hardcoded in HTML). Q1 trip type (Mountains & trekking, Lakes & green valleys, Culture & heritage, Snow & skiing using assets/images/quiz-mountains.jpg, quiz-lakes.jpg, quiz-culture.jpg, quiz-snow.jpg). Others: trip length (3-4 / 5-7 / 8+ days), budget, travel season, travel group. Text-only cards for these.
2. "Question X of 5" and an animated progress bar.
3. Option cards act like radio buttons: one selected at a time, green border + light fill + tick, fully keyboard usable (Tab, arrow keys, Enter/Space), proper aria roles.
4. Next with nothing selected shows an inline error (aria-live). Back goes to the previous question and keeps the earlier answer. On the last question Next becomes "See my match".
5. Scoring: each option adds points to destinations stored in a JS array (Hunza, Skardu, Swat, Naran-Kaghan, Fairy Meadows), each with name, short description, best season, suggested days and one of the 4 quiz images. Highest score wins; handle ties with a clear rule.
6. Result screen: "Your Match: <destination>", image with alt text, description, a short "why this matched" line from the answers, View Package button (link to ../pages/tour-packages.html) and Retake button (clears answers, back to Q1).
7. Save progress and the last result in localStorage so a reload continues where the user left off; show the last match if the quiz was completed.
8. Responsive (2x2 cards desktop, stacked mobile per design), visible focus states, alt text on all images.

Finish with a list of files created and a step-by-step test checklist including edge cases.

DESTINATIONS array holds metadata for the 5 Northern Pakistan destinations.\n * 2. QUIZ_QUESTIONS array holds all 5 questions and weighted scoring per option.\n * 3. UI is rendered dynamically from QUIZ_QUESTIONS (nothing hardcoded in HTML).\n * 4. Option cards implement WAI-ARIA radiogroup keyboard navigation (Tab + Arrows + Enter/Space).\n * 5. State (currentStep, answers, completed result) is persisted in localStorage.\n */\n(function () {\n  \"use strict\";\n\n  var STORAGE_KEY = \"hh_find_your_trip_state\";\n\n  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n     1. DESTINATIONS DATA\n     Order in this array also serves as the final tie-breaker if two\n     destinations match on both total score and Question 1 score.\n     ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */\n  var DESTINATIONS = [\n    {\n      id: \"hunza\",\n      name: \"Hunza\",\n      description:\n        \"Terraced apricot orchards, ancient stone forts, and panoramic views of Rakaposhi and Ultar Sar along the Karakoram Highway.\",\n      bestSeason: \"Spring \u0026 Autumn (Apr–May, Sep–Oct)\",\n      suggestedDays: \"5–7 days\",\n      image: \"../assets/images/quiz-culture.jpg\",\n      imageAlt: \"Ancient stone fort perched above green terraced fields and mountain peaks in Hunza Valley\"\n    },\n    {\n      id: \"skardu\",\n      name: \"Skardu\",\n      description:\n        \"Gateway to K2, Shangrila's mirror lakes, cold desert dunes, and dramatic granite peaks in Baltistan.\",\n      bestSeason: \"Summer \u0026 Early Autumn (Jun–Sep)\",\n      suggestedDays: \"7–10 days\",\n      image: \"../assets/images/quiz-mountains.jpg\",\n      imageAlt: \"Traditional stone village nestled beneath towering snow-capped mountains in Baltistan\"\n    },\n    {\n      id: \"swat\",\n      name: \"Swat\",\n      description:\n        \"Lush pine valleys, emerald rivers, Buddhist heritage sites, and winter slopes at Malam Jabba.\",\n      bestSeason: \"All year (Winter for snow, Summer for valleys)\",\n      suggestedDays: \"3–5 days\",\n      image: \"../assets/images/quiz-snow.jpg\",\n      imageAlt: \"Snow-covered pine forests and ski slopes in Malam Jabba, Swat Valley\"\n    },\n    {\n      id: \"naranKaghan\",\n      name: \"Naran-Kaghan\",\n      description:\n        \"Alpine lakes like Saif-ul-Malook, flower-filled meadows, and crisp mountain air within easy reach.\",\n      bestSeason: \"Summer (Jun–Aug)\",\n      suggestedDays: \"3–5 days\",\n      image: \"../assets/images/quiz-lakes.jpg\",\n      imageAlt: \"Still alpine lake surrounded by evergreen pines and green valley pastures in Naran-Kaghan\"\n    },\n    {\n      id: \"fairyMeadows\",\n      name: \"Fairy Meadows\",\n      description:\n        \"An iconic high-altitude meadow camp facing the towering north face of Nanga Parbat.\",\n      bestSeason: \"Summer \u0026 Early Autumn (Jun–Sep)\",\n      suggestedDays: \"5–7 days\",\n      image: \"../assets/images/quiz-mountains.jpg\",\n      imageAlt: \"High-altitude mountain trail and alpine village beneath snow-capped peaks\"\n    }\n  ];\n\n  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n     2. QUIZ QUESTIONS DATA (5 Questions, Data-Driven)\n     Question 1 includes image cards; Questions 2–5 are text-only cards.\n     Each option awards points toward matching destinations.\n     ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */\n  var QUIZ_QUESTIONS = [\n    {\n      id: \"tripType\",\n      question: \"What kind of trip are you dreaming of?\",\n      reasonPrefix: \"your interest in\",\n      options: [\n        {\n          id: \"mountains\",\n          label: \"Mountains \u0026 trekking\",\n          subtitle: \"High trails. Wide-open horizons.\",\n          image: \"../assets/images/quiz-mountains.jpg\",\n          imageAlt: \"Stone mountain village surrounded by tall poplars and high peaks\",\n          scores: { fairyMeadows: 4, skardu: 4, hunza: 2 }\n        },\n        {\n          id: \"lakes\",\n          label: \"Lakes \u0026 green valleys\",\n          subtitle: \"Slow days beside still waters.\",\n          image: \"../assets/images/quiz-lakes.jpg\",\n          imageAlt: \"Clear alpine lake reflecting pine trees and grassy slopes\",\n          scores: { naranKaghan: 4, swat: 3, skardu: 2 }\n        },\n        {\n          id: \"culture\",\n          label: \"Culture \u0026 heritage\",\n          subtitle: \"Stories etched in stone.\",\n          image: \"../assets/images/quiz-culture.jpg\",\n          imageAlt: \"Historic stone fort overlooking a lush mountain valley\",\n          scores: { hunza: 4, swat: 3, skardu: 2 }\n        },\n        {\n          id: \"snow\",\n          label: \"Snow \u0026 skiing\",\n          subtitle: \"A little winter adventure.\",\n          image: \"../assets/images/quiz-snow.jpg\",\n          imageAlt: \"Snowy pine forest and mountain ski resort slopes\",\n          scores: { swat: 5, naranKaghan: 2, hunza: 1 }\n        }\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      id: \"tripLength\",\n      question: \"How many days do you have for your journey?\",\n      reasonPrefix: \"a\",\n      options: [\n        {\n          id: \"short\",\n          label: \"3–4 days\",\n          subtitle: \"A refreshing long-weekend escape.\",\n          scores: { swat: 3, naranKaghan: 3, hunza: 1 }\n        },\n        {\n          id: \"medium\",\n          label: \"5–7 days\",\n          subtitle: \"Enough time to explore at an easy pace.\",\n          scores: { hunza: 3, fairyMeadows: 3, swat: 2, naranKaghan: 2 }\n        },\n        {\n          id: \"long\",\n          label: \"8+ days\",\n          subtitle: \"Deep northern expedition across passes.\",\n          scores: { skardu: 4, hunza: 3, fairyMeadows: 2 }\n        }\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      id: \"budget\",\n      question: \"What travel budget feels most comfortable?\",\n      reasonPrefix: \"a\",\n      options: [\n        {\n          id: \"budget\",\n          label: \"Budget-friendly\",\n          subtitle: \"Guesthouses, shared transport \u0026 local dhabas.\",\n          scores: { Evaluating test combinations against the scoring logic in the trip finder script. Tracing the Hunza path shows weights accumulating across cultural heritage, duration, mid-range comfort, and spring travel parameters, but need to verify if these combined point totals definitively outweigh alternative destinations across all four questions.

Finalizing the Skardu profile points confirms mountain focus, extended duration, and luxury parameters decisively outrank alternatives. ### 1. Root Cause & Fixes
The issue was caused by **(a)** & **(c)**: `loadState()` trusted a previously saved `matchedDestinationId` from `localStorage` without verifying/recalculating from the 5 answers, and `state.answers` was keyed by string IDs rather than a fixed 5-slot question-index array (`0..4`), while Swat also accumulated points across too many non-snow options.

Fixed in [find-your-trip.js](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/assets/js/find-your-trip.js), [find-your-trip.html](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/pages/find-your-trip.html), and [find-your-trip.css](file:///Users/muhammadabdullah/Documents/Highland-Horizons/assets/css/find-your-trip.css):
- `state.answers` now stores answers by question index (`[null, null, null, null, null]`) for questions `0..4`.
- Clicking **See my match** always calls `calculateBestDestination()` from the current 5 answers before saving to `localStorage`, and `loadState()` validates all 5 answers and recalculates on reload.
- Clicking **Retake** resets `state.currentStep = 0`, `state.answers = [null, null, null, null, null]`, `state.completed = false`, `state.matchedDestinationId = null`, and removes `hh_find_your_trip_state` from `localStorage`.
- Rebalanced `QUIZ_QUESTIONS` scoring so each destination has clear winning paths.
- Restored the destination description (`#resultDescription`) and dynamic `"Why this matched"` line (`#resultWhyMatched`) on the result screen alongside **Best Season** and **Suggested Duration**.

---

### 2. 5 Test Answer Combinations (One per Destination)

1. **Hunza** (`18` pts)
   - Q1: `Culture & heritage` → Q2: `5–7 days` → Q3: `Mid-range comfort` → Q4: `Spring (Mar–May)` → Q5: `Couple`
2. **Skardu** (`19` pts)
   - Q1: `Mountains & trekking` → Q2: `8+ days` → Q3: `Premium & private` → Q4: `Autumn (Sep–Nov)` → Q5: `Friends / adventure group`
3. **Fairy Meadows** (`19` pts)
   - Q1: `Mountains & trekking` → Q2: `5–7 days` → Q3: `Budget-friendly` → Q4: `Summer (Jun–Aug)` → Q5: `Solo traveller`
4. **Naran-Kaghan** (`18` pts)
   - Q1: `Lakes & green valleys` → Q2: `3–4 days` → Q3: `Budget-friendly` → Q4: `Summer (Jun–Aug)` → Q5: `Family with kids`
5. **Swat** (`18` pts)
   - Q1: `Snow & skiing` → Q2: `3–4 days` → Q3: `Mid-range comfort` → Q4: `Winter (Dec–Feb)` → Q5: `Family with kids`
